annotations.title: Map sitemap URLs against citation cache

description: Cross-reference a sitemap with the citation cache. For each sitemap URL, reports whether it appears in cached citations (and how many queries/engines cited it). Inverse of audit_sitemap: not 'how citable is each URL', but 'has each URL actually been cited yet'. Cache must be primed via check_citations or run_panel first.

domain.description: Domain to look up citations for. If omitted, inferred from the sitemap host.

since.description: ISO date floor; only count citations recorded on or after this date.

sitemap_url.description: URL of sitemap.xml (or a sitemap index). Nested sitemaps are followed.

name: audit_sitemap_map

citations_in_cache.description: Total citation cache entries for this domain.

coverage_pct.description: Percentage of sitemap URLs that have been cited (0-100).

domain.description: Domain whose citation cache was queried.

mapped.description: URLs found in the citation cache.

mapped_urls.description: Sitemap URLs present in the cache, sorted by citation count desc.

unmapped.description: URLs not yet seen in the citation cache.

unmapped_urls.description: Sitemap URLs not yet cited (up to 200).
